# awacino_invitation (Resource)

A new invitation code for a member who has not joined yet (status `invited`). Issuing it revokes the member's older code. Change `triggers` to issue another code. Destroying the resource revokes the open code; the member stays `invited` until a new code is issued or the member is removed.

Needs the key section **Users** (Write).

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "awacino_member" "anna" {
  email = "anna@it-partner.example"
  role  = "read"
}

# A fresh invitation code for a member who has not joined yet (revokes the older one).
# Change `round` to issue another one.
resource "awacino_invitation" "anna" {
  member_id = awacino_member.anna.id
  days      = 3
  send_mail = true
  locale    = "en"

  triggers = {
    round = "2"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `member_id` (String) The invited member (`awacino_member.x.id`).

### Optional

- `days` (Number) Days the code is valid (1-14, default 7).
- `locale` (String) Mail language (ISO 639-1). Default `en`.
- `send_mail` (Boolean) `true`: Awacino mails the invited address. Default `false` (send `join_url` yourself).
- `triggers` (Map of String) Any values; a change issues a new code (and revokes the old one).

### Read-Only

- `code` (String, Sensitive) The invitation code (`AWA-XXXX-XXXX-XXXX`). Only known when it was issued; keep your state in an encrypted backend.
- `expires_at` (String) When the code ends.
- `id` (String) The member id.
- `join_url` (String, Sensitive) `https://www.awacino.com/join/#<code>`.
- `mailed` (Boolean) Whether Awacino mailed it.
- `state` (String) `open`, `expired` or `used` (the member joined).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By member id (the code itself cannot be imported - it is stored as a hash only)
terraform import awacino_invitation.anna 1234
```
